claim: AIHW Hospitals at a glance Table 2 reports 9,094,312 emergency department presentation events for 2024–25 at the Australian public-hospital emergency departments represented in the named database. This is the displayed annual aggregate total, not unique people, an arrival rate, a temporal process or a generic/Cairns ED default. The accompanying total denominator is all presentations.
